unsupported: The parent company, JU-YOUNG Mechatronics Co., Ltd., was founded in South Korea in 1979 and expanded globally with factories in the Philippines (1991), Mexico (2005), and the United States (2016).
The Alabama facility represents the company’s most recent production base, serving North American customers from a strategic location in the automotive corridor.
Manufacturing processes center on precision metal stamping and assembly, though the company does not disclose specific equipment lists, facility square footage, or headcount for the Montgomery site.
Primary customers are automotive OEMs and tier suppliers requiring stamped and assembled metal components.
The digital door lock and DOGSPLAY lines extend the company’s reach into consumer electronics and pet-care markets, respectively.
JU-YOUNG states its mission is to create a better future for customers, employees, and society through dedicated global operations.
The company emphasizes its multi-country footprint and integrated quality management as key differentiators, allowing it to support diverse product programs from a single organizational structure.
